short_description: Drive the Formula G27 in a single-player open-wheel simcade. Master 18 track layouts, race AI rivals, upgrade your car through a 22-event career, and earn medals.
about_this_game:
FORMULA 2027 GRAND PRIX LEGENDS
EVERY CORNER COUNTS.
Take the wheel of the Formula G27 and experience the challenge of open-wheel racing. From the starting lights to the final corner, every braking point, racing line, and acceleration decision can make the difference.
Formula 2027 Grand Prix Legends combines accessible simcade handling with a single-player career built around racing, improving your skills, and developing your car.
RACE THROUGH A 22-EVENT CAREER
Start with your first practice laps and work your way toward the season finale.
Compete against three AI rivals, complete timed challenges, and earn bronze, silver, or gold medals. Each event brings new objectives and opportunities to improve your performance.
Earn credits, gain experience, unlock new events, and return to previous races to achieve better results.
BUILD YOUR FORMULA CAR
Your Formula G27 grows with you throughout your career.
Invest your earned credits in four upgrade categories:
■ Engine — Improve torque and acceleration.
■ Brakes — Enhance braking performance.
■ Suspension — Refine handling and chassis control.
■ Aerodynamics — Increase downforce for faster corners.
Choose between Balanced, Speed, and Corners setups to adapt your car to different challenges.
MASTER 18 TRACK CONFIGURATIONS
Race across 18 circuit configurations featuring varied layouts and environments.
From alpine scenery and autumn landscapes to winter surroundings, wet circuits, and illuminated night races, every setting brings a different atmosphere to the track.
Learn the braking zones, respect track limits, and find the racing line that works best for you.
THREE WAYS TO RACE BEYOND CAREER MODE
Quick Race — Compete in a three-lap race against three AI opponents using your upgraded car.
Time Attack — Chase your fastest valid lap in a standardized car configuration, where driving skill makes the difference.
Practice — Explore each circuit at your own pace and refine your driving technique.
MAKE THE CAR YOURS
Choose from eight distinct liveries and give your Formula G27 its own racing identity.
Personalize your car's appearance without sacrificing your technical progression. Your upgrades remain available as you switch between liveries.
FIND YOUR LIMIT. THEN PUSH FURTHER.
Experience responsive open-wheel handling with adjustable driving assists, multiple camera perspectives, and a motorsport-inspired racing HUD.
Improve your lap times, collect medals, develop your car, and prove yourself across the career.
The next corner is another chance to get faster.
